title: Move the site builder into tad-engine
note: Every repository that renders reStructuredText from the template needs the same site; the builder belongs in the engine so that it is pulled, not copied. It needs the page list and navigation to come from the rendered pages rather than from this repository's fixed list.

title: Measure what uses the playbook's Python, port the live files to Rust, retire the rest
note: Practice 21: no Python of our own. kit/guards/*.py, kit/rust/*.py, kit/scripts/*.py and tools/*.py (build_site, check_paths, check_rst) run in make test, rst and site. First measure what still calls each file (Makefile, CI, kit templates), then port the live ones to Rust (rust-script for a single file, a crate where it repeats) and delete the rest with their tests. Shell only for true one-off glue that strings commands together: the author, 2026-11-19, 'shell is even worse than python for any scripts that isnt a one off glue'.
